params.prompt: VO: 'psychologists combined more than ten studies on this'. SCENE: a research office. The SCIENTIST from the cast sheet (white hair, round glasses, white lab coat, fifth sprite) sits at a wooden desk beside a tall neat stack of research papers and folders, reading one paper held in both hands; a bookshelf behind. ONE ACTION: reading a paper. CAST (copy from the cast reference sheet): MASCOT = black hair, navy suit jacket, white shirt, orange tie, navy trousers (first sprite). GIRLFRIEND = long dark-brown hair, golden-yellow top, brown skirt (second sprite). Only these characters unless stated. STYLE (must match the reference images): 16-bit retro pixel-art game scene, vertical 9:16 phone frame. Chunky, clearly visible square pixels on a consistent grid (the whole image looks like ~216x384 pixel art scaled up with nearest-neighbour), clean 1-pixel dark ink outlines (#0C0E1A), flat colour fills with 1-2 step pixel shading, clear light from the upper left. Colours ONLY from the channel palette in the palette reference: warm orange #F58A24, wooden brown #805638, midnight navy #172442, muted pixel blue #294575, warm beige #E2C4A0, golden yellow #F0BA3C, soft ivory #F5E8C9, ink #0C0E1A, red #E82A2A (plus darker/lighter tints of these). Roughly 60% dominant colour, 30% secondary, 10% orange-gold accent. Characters are simple chibi sprites exactly like the cast reference sheet (big head, dot eyes, small body, mitten-like hands with a visible thumb, hands always attached to arms). Detail hierarchy: characters simple; the main object of the scene drawn with MORE pixel detail so its real-world structure is instantly recognisable. Simple uncluttered background, main subject large and centred in the upper two-thirds of the frame; keep the bottom 20% calm and plain (subtitles go there). Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or UI in the image.
